note: miniOrange SAML SP is an external SAML SSO integration, but every setting persists locally in the miniorange_saml.settings config object, so all cases are grounded in local config (no external IdP or network needed). Key facts: SP-initiated login /samllogin, ACS /samlassertion, SP metadata /saml_metadata; configure route miniorange_saml.sp_setup; IdP keys miniorange_saml_idp_name/_idp_issuer/_idp_login_url/_idp_x509_certificate; attribute mapping miniorange_saml_username_attribute/_email_attribute default 'NameID'; default NameID format urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:unspecified. Medium cases seed known IdP/attribute values and read them back; hard cases write specific IdP details / attribute mappings, verified against live config. Baselines (shipped install defaults: idp_* = '', attributes = 'NameID') are restored explicitly.

evals.prompt: On a Drupal 11 site with the miniOrange SAML SP module, what is the URL/path a user hits to start SP-initiated SAML single sign-on, and what does it do?
evals.expected_output: /samllogin (route miniorange_saml.saml_login) builds a SAML AuthnRequest and redirects the user to the configured IdP login URL. The IdP posts the assertion back to the ACS at /samlassertion.

evals.prompt: In the miniOrange SAML SP module, which config object stores its settings, and which key holds the external IdP's SSO/login URL that AuthnRequests are sent to?
evals.expected_output: Settings live in the miniorange_saml.settings config object; the IdP SSO URL is miniorange_saml_idp_login_url (alongside miniorange_saml_idp_issuer, _idp_name and _idp_x509_certificate).

evals.prompt: Out of the box, which SAML attribute does the miniOrange SAML SP module use to determine a user's Drupal username and email?
evals.expected_output: Both miniorange_saml_username_attribute and miniorange_saml_email_attribute default to NameID.

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has the miniOrange SAML SP module configured to talk to an external Identity Provider. Inspect the live configuration and give the IdP's SSO/login URL that the module sends SAML AuthnRequests to.
On this site the miniOrange SAML SP attribute mapping has been customised. Inspect the live configuration and state which SAML attribute is mapped to the Drupal user's email address.

Configure the miniOrange SAML SP module to trust an external Identity Provider with these details: IdP name 'Corp IdP', IdP entity id / issuer 'https://idp.corp-h1.example.com/entity', and IdP SSO login URL 'https://idp.corp-h1.example.com/sso'. Apply the change to the live site.

Configure the miniOrange SAML SP attribute mapping so that the SAML attribute 'EmailAddress' is used for the Drupal email and the SAML attribute 'Username' is used for the Drupal username. Apply the change to the live site.
